Why: your recorded decision says 'Linear algebra refresh paused since 2026-06-12; resume only the SVD stage, and only as far as the L09 exam scope needs'. Coordination also records that the L09 (PCA/SVD) gap depends on it. L09 is exam scope (scope: '…the SVD of the centred data matrix, explained variance'), its stage 2 'Connect PCA to the SVD' is marked exam-critical and has been paused since 2026-06-10, and your retake is on 2026-10-06, which is primary until then. What exactly (about 1–2 sessions): (1) you already have the SVD geometry: refresh stage 1 is complete and note-svd-geometric has AᵀA = VΣᵀΣVᵀ; (2) finish L09 stage 2 from where you stopped: centred X = UΣVᵀ ⇒ covariance XᵀX/n = V(Σ²/n)Vᵀ, so V's columns are the principal directions and the eigenvalues are σ_i²/n. That answers your open 'σ_i²/n?', and the explained-variance fraction of component i is σ_i²/Σσ_j². Check it numerically on the 2-D toy data from note-pca-by-hand (SVD vs eigh). Resource on the stage: Bishop §12.1. Done when: a short proof in your own words. (3) Don't restart the rest: the image-compression experiment (refresh stage 2, not exam-critical) and the recommender question stay paused until after the exams (after 2026-10-12). Your SL workspace still asks whether the SVD proof or only the PCA computation gets examined; the step above covers both. Keep it small, because L07 (regularization) is recorded as your biggest gap.
